items.briefing:
Australia and New Zealand are experiencing a surge in critical software vulnerabilities, and cybercriminals are increasingly using AI to launch attacks at greater speed and scale. Ransomware groups are at record numbers globally, and overall cyberattacks rose sharply in July — trends that directly affect Australian organisations of all sizes, including registered training organisations handling sensitive student data.

A global attack campaign is also actively exploiting a serious flaw in VMware vCenter servers, which are commonly used in Australian business environments. If your organisation uses VMware, check with your IT team that patches have been applied. **Practical tip:** Ensure all software and server updates are applied promptly — unpatched systems remain the most common entry point for attackers.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical patch backlogs expose Australian organisations to 85 high-impact security vulnerabilities.
